records.name: Casey Crabill
records.notes: Retired in 2022 after 9 years leading OCC; SUNY confirmed her successor Warren Hilton in 2022.

records.name: Warren M. Hilton
records.priorTitle: Vice President for Enrollment Management and Student Affairs
records.notes: Ninth president of OCC and first Black president; began July 1, 2022, following a nationwide search led by RH Perry & Associates.

records.name: Georgia Costello
records.notes: Retired effective June 30, 2018 after a decade as SWIC president.

records.name: Nick J. Mance
records.notes: A CPA and 25-year SWIC trustee (20 as board chairman), he resigned from the board in 2018 to become a candidate and was appointed president that July, replacing retiring president Georgia Costello. Still president as of the 2025-2026 academic year per SWIC's own materials.

records.name: Jessica Stumpf
records.notes: Interim president beginning July 2011 when Anoka-Ramsey Community College and Anoka Technical College were aligned under one shared president position ahead of Hanson's permanent appointment.

records.name: Kent Hanson
records.notes: Named president of both Anoka-Ramsey Community College and Anoka Technical College by the MnSCU Board of Trustees on Feb 26, 2013, effective July 2013; marked a decade-plus in the role as of 2023.

records.name: Bob Kratochvil
records.notes: Retired as LMC president in late 2022; Pamela Ralston stepped in as his successor.

records.name: Pamela Ralston
records.notes: Seventh president of LMC. Began as interim president in January 2023 succeeding retiring president Bob Kratochvil; Contra Costa Community College District's Governing Board made her permanent in June 2023.

records.name: Daniel Walden
records.notes: Current Superintendent/President of Victor Valley College; selected for the role per an August 13, 2019 Victor Valley Daily Press report ('Walden selected as next VVC superintendent/president'). Prior/predecessor president could not be confirmed from available sources -- flagging a research gap here.

records.name: Bob Burns
records.notes: First president of NWACC; invested February 5, 1990, shortly after the college's 1989 founding. (A second president served at some point between Burns and Jorgenson, whose identity was not confirmed in available sources.)

records.name: Evelyn Jorgenson
records.notes: Invested as NWACC's third president in July 2013; retired June 30, 2022.

records.name: Dennis C. Rittle
records.notes: Became NWACC president after Jorgenson's 2022 retirement; also previously served as Ozarka College Provost/EVP of Learning. Board approved a raise and contract extension to 2032 in May 2025.

records.name: Jean Goodnow
records.notes: Fourth president of Delta College, following Peter Boyse (1992-2005) and Don Carlyon (1963-1992).

records.name: Mike Gavin
records.notes: Fifth president of Delta College; succeeded by Michelle Allmendinger in 2026.

records.name: Michelle Allmendinger
records.notes: Sixth president of Delta College (University Center, MI), began June 29, 2026, succeeding Mike Gavin. Career path included dean of students/development roles at Clinton Community College and Scott Community College, both in Iowa.

records.name: Jim M. Yeonopolus
records.notes: Named CTC chancellor in December 2015; led the Killeen, TX-based college until Michele Carter's 2023 appointment.

records.name: Michele Carter
records.notes: Current Chancellor of Central Texas College (Killeen); promoted internally after 32 years at CTC ('Rising to the top: Carter takes helm as chancellor after 32 years at CTC', 2023).

records.name: Richard T. Anderson
records.notes: Ed.D., retired as WCTC president/director in 2002 (successors between him and Betzig not fully confirmed).

records.name: Kaylen Betzig
records.notes: Retired as WCTC president at the end of December 2020; exact start year not confirmed in available sources.

records.name: Richard Barnhouse
records.priorTitle: Vice President of Student Services and Enrollment Management
records.notes: Began as WCTC president on January 5, 2021, succeeding retiring president Kaylen Betzig; earlier career included student affairs/enrollment roles including at Rice University.

seats.university: UCNJ Union College of Union County, New Jersey

records.name: Derek N. Nunney
records.notes: First president of Union County College who was not a faculty member at inauguration; followed Saul Orkin (1974-1983, who died in office in 1983).

records.name: Thomas H. Brown
records.notes: Led the college through significant expansion, including new urban campuses in Elizabeth and Plainfield; served until 2010.

records.name: Margaret M. McMenamin
records.notes: First female president of the college (renamed UCNJ Union College of Union County, NJ in recent years); appointed July 2010 and still serving as of the most recent available sources.

records.name: Bill Ihlenfeldt
records.notes: Served as CVTC president 1994-2008, preceding Bruce Barker.

records.name: Bruce Barker
records.notes: Immediate predecessor to Sunem Beaton-Garcia, serving 2008-2021.

records.name: Sunem Beaton-Garcia
records.notes: Eleventh president of CVTC; first woman and first Latina to lead the college. Took office July 2021; formally invested September 10-15, 2023.

records.name: Margaret Burke Lee
records.notes: Served roughly 30 years as Oakton (Community College) president before retiring in June 2015; the college's Science and Health Careers Center is named for her.

records.name: Joianne L. Smith
records.notes: Fourth and current president of Oakton College (renamed from Oakton Community College); has served since July 1, 2015.

records.name: Lynda Villanueva
records.notes: Immediate predecessor to Jacob Atkin at Lee College (Baytown, TX); her exact start year was not confirmed in available sources, and her departure preceded Atkin's Feb 2026 interim appointment.

records.name: Jacob Atkin
records.priorTitle: Chief Financial Officer and EVP of Finance and Administration
records.notes: Eleventh president of Lee College. Joined Lee College as CFO/EVP of Finance and Administration in 2025, became interim president February 26, 2026, and was named permanent president June 18, 2026. Previously Associate VC for Finance at Houston City College and spent 18 years at Utah Valley University.

records.name: Landon Pirius
records.priorTitle: Vice Chancellor for Academic and Student Affairs
records.notes: Tenth president of Red Rocks Community College; assumed duties in March 2024. Prior career included roles at North Hennepin Community College and Inver Hills Community College in Minnesota. Predecessor (ninth president) not confirmed from available sources -- flagging a research gap here.

records.name: John J. Swalec, Jr.
records.notes: Third president of Waubonsee; presided over more than 50% growth and two new campuses, plus 50 new instructional programs, over 20 years.

records.name: Christine J. Sobek
records.notes: Fourth president, serving 21.5 years (44.5 years total in Illinois community colleges); oversaw a Master Plan completing five new buildings on time and on budget.

records.name: Brian Knetl
records.priorTitle: Provost and Executive Vice President of Academic and Student Affairs
records.notes: Fifth president of Waubonsee Community College; began January 30, 2023, succeeding Christine J. Sobek.

records.name: Julie A. (Manley) White
records.notes: Current Chancellor and CEO of the two-campus Pierce College District (Fort Steilacoom and Puyallup, WA); selected November 2022, effective January 1, 2023. She had served as president of the Fort Steilacoom campus since 2019. Her predecessor as district chancellor was not confirmed from available sources -- flagging a research gap here.

records.name: G. Brent Wallace
records.notes: Became NCTC's 11th president and first Chancellor in August 2014, promoted internally from VP of Instruction; still serving as Chancellor/CEO as of 2026. Predecessor (10th president) not confirmed from available sources -- flagging a research gap here.

records.name: Barry A. Russell
records.priorTitle: staff in the Office of the Chancellor
records.notes: Sixth president of Las Positas College; appointed December 2013 after working in the CA Community Colleges Chancellor's office.

records.name: Dyrell Foster
records.notes: Current president of Las Positas College (part of the Chabot-Las Positas Community College District), in office as of November 2023.
